prior_operator_scope: The bucket size comparison at 608 cards is terminal. This changes only whether DDP gradient tensors share the established bucket storage. This is a separate two-armed measurement with a new 8-card pilot.
design: Use original 25 MiB DDP bucket cap throughout. Compare gradient_as_bucket_view False/True/True/False with the same input, initialization, AdamW and four microbatches. Record actually shared gradient storages, training update deltas, steady allocated and peak bytes, and slowest-rank timings. Pilot uses 1 numerical 1 warm and 2 timed steps per block; fleet uses 1/3/15. No extra optimizer, precision or bucket capacity change.
environment: Pinned original DTK sandbox and RCCL. Generated repeatable inputs, complete shape-defined LoRA-only forward/backward and AdamW, no frozen full model.
exclusions: Keep old MiniCPM original request reservations and two previously observed external KFD holders. Node worker independently checks current KFD and PCI.
formal_qualification: No native full-model numeric, A100 throughput, recovery, held-out or Stage3 claims.
